annotations.title: Explain a build, launch or store error

description: Explain a React Native or Expo build, launch, crash or store-review error: what it means and the fix, from errors NativeKeel has reproduced or verified against Apple, Google, Expo and React Native documentation. Pass the error message (or the failing part of the log) and, optionally, the project path to see where this project is affected. Call it before searching the web or changing versions.

error.description: The error message or the relevant part of the build log.

offline.description: Default true: the project check runs without network requests.

path.description: Folder of the React Native or Expo app, to point at the place in this project the error comes from. Optional.

name: explain_error
